edge delete, everything went and the edg.stdout:

the edge was restarted so Traefik reloads the store — it holds it in memory and rewrites the whole file, so an edit made underneath it comes back. Every other name is served again; routes are files.
kept acme/issued.json — the issuance ledger is what `tls-status` counts against Let's Encrypt's five-a-week duplicate limit. Deleting the certificate does NOT give the budget back; re-issuing the same name still counts.
